selection_basis: Three prespecified disjoint-seed prediction-only budget pilots; held-out prediction error slightly lower at doubled budget in each; no comparator or IV truth performance inspected.
limitations: This modest sampler budget is not certified converged; prediction chain discrepancies are algorithmic stability indicators. One abrupt-pilot adoption prediction changed by 0.0744 training SD under doubling.
final_source_change: Only default burnin100->200 and draws200->400; pilots passed these explicitly.
